sourceData.mnemonic: Your <kanji>house</kanji> <kanji>tools</kanji> aren't the tools you use to build a house. They're more like the things that are a part of your house that you use like tools. Those things would be your <vocabulary>furniture</vocabulary>. So, remember, your house tools are just furniture.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: This is a jukugo word, which usually means on'yomi readings from the kanji. If you know the readings of your kanji you'll know how to read this as well.
